tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sbus skyed rten gyi 'dod gsol dge/ bla ma dam pa dang dpal rdo rje sems dpa' tha mi dad pa'i zhabs la sbus sde skyed tshal lha sde mi sde kun rnam kun phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /rjes su bzung du gsol/ phyogs 'di'i skye bo rnams kyis tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas da lta'i bar du bsags pa'i bcas rang sdig ltung ci mchis dang / de las byung ba'i snod bcud sdug phongs ji snyed byang zhing dag nas mi sde kun gyi mi nor phyugs sogs longs spyod dar zhing rgyas nas dge ba'i gzhir 'gyur ba dang / lha sde dar zhing tshul khrims dag la thos bsam bsgom gsum rje btsun sa skya pa'i lta grub rnam par dag pas rang gzhan la gnas skabs mthar thug gi dgos 'dod ma lus pa 'grub par byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ rab dga'i sar gnas rgyal ba'i sras rnams kyis/ /dgongs pa gcig tu btab pa'i smon lam mchog /bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam ji lta bar/ /bdag dang 'gro bas myur du 'grub par shog /mdor na bdag kyang khyed kyi thugs rje yis/ /tshe ring nad med dpal 'byor rgyas pa dang / /rnam dag khrims ldan 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyis/ /rgyal ba'i bstan la bya ba byed par shog /mdor na sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /thugs kyi dgongs pa legs tshogs ji snyed kun/ /bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pas/ /myur du 'grub par byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ /ces 'di sbus sde skyed tshal bas/ /rten gyi nang gzhug 'dod gsol du/ /gzims phug sprul sku'i bzhed pa bzhin/ /sa skya kun blos gong dkar bris/ ༈ /bum sgrub skabs kyi 'dod gsol dge/ nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam 'gro ba'i dbul sel zhing / /khyad par yul phyogs 'di yi 'byor phongs sel/ /char chu dus 'bab lo phyugs legs shing rgyas/ /mi phyugs nad med gdon bgegs gdug rtsub zhi/ /zhing la than btswa' sad ser 'bu gnod sogs/

/lo dgra'i gnod srungs sos char snga ba dang / /gung char snyoms shing ston zhod med pa dang / /kha ba'i 'jigs bral nyi drod rlung bsil sogs/ /mdor na zhing phan gang la gang dgos rnams/ /de dang de las 'byung zhing rigs rnams kyang / /rtswa bcud 'phel dang klung gi rtswa rigs kyang / /rab tu rgyas shing mdzod kun 'bru rigs kyis/ /phyur bur gtams la 'o zho mar la sogs/ /bcud kyi longs spyod ri dang rgya mtsho ltar/ /rab tu rgyas nas snyigs dus mu ge'i gnod/ /ming yang mi grags sa g.yo 'bab chus gnod/ /me 'bar rlung sogs 'byung bzhi ma rungs kun/ /phan grogs kho nar gyur nas rdzogs ldan ltar/ /dud 'gro rnams ni skad snyan lus nyams bde/ /mi rnams gos dar lhab lhub gos kyis spras/ /rin chen rgyan gyis spud nas rtsed 'jo dang / /snyan pa'i glu len dga' ba'i gar bro 'khrab/ /skyid pa'i rnam 'gyur ha hi a la la'i/ /gad mos nyin mtshan 'da' zhing bza' btung kun/ /ye shes bdud rtsi lta bu'i ro myangs pas/ /sprang po'i ming mi 'byung dang las kyi khral/ /kun la thogs med mi nor phyugs gsum la/ /shar ba'i dge mtshan dpon 'bangs kun mthun sogs/ /mdor na sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /thugs kyi dgongs pa legs tshogs ji snyed kun/ /bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pas/ /myur du 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol// ༈ /snal gdong chos mdzad zhal 'dod gsol// oṃ ma hā kā la kā la/ bi kā la/ ra tri ta/ ḍombhi nī/ tsaṇḍa lī/ rakkha sī/ siṅga lī de bi hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam tshig bdag gis gsol btab rjes su dgongs par mdzod la dpal rdo rje nag po chen po/ lha mchog ma hā kā la/ lha chen nag po zhal bzhi/ bram ze'i gzugs can dpa' bo yum chen g.yung mo nag mo/ las mdzad gtum mo ljang gu/ ser nag siṅga lī/

dmar nag srin mo chen mo/ bka' nyan dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rten 'di la brtan par bzhugs nas sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros rigs myug zung dang bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rje btsun blo bzang bstan pa'i dbang phyug 'jam dpal rgya mtsho dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i 'gal rkyen sol/ mthun rkyen spel/ thugs kyi bzhed don thams cad ji lta ba bzhin 'grub nas bstan 'gro'i dpal mgon dam par 'gyur ba'i phrin las mdzod cig gzhan yang bdag la nye bar mkho ba gtsang nya mo sbal gdong pa'i rje drung skal bzang chos grags ltos par bcas pa'i bsam dgu lhun gyis 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod cig mdor na sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /thugs kyi dgongs pa legs tshogs ji snyed kun/ /bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pas/ /myur du 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ༈ /srid zhi'i dga' tshal du de mo rin po che'i snang brnyan 'dod gsol dge/ oṃ swasti/ mchog gsum rtsa gsum kun 'dus snyigs dus bstan 'gro spyi bye'i dpal mgon dam pa ngag dbang 'jam dpal bde legs rgya mtsho'i snang brnyan rin po che sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros kyis dad rten du bzhengs shing / dpal bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang dang / 'dab 'byor pho brang chen po srid zhi dga' tshal gyi mgon khang chen mor bzhugs su gsol ba 'di la bdag gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa rnams dang / dpal sa skya'i gdung rabs zhal slob mkhas grub zhal slob rim byon rnams dang / yang phur/ bde kyai gsang gsum/ tshe dpag med mgon sogs yi dam sangs rgyas ji snyed/ rigs gsum mgon po sogs byang sems/ rdo rje nag po chen po sogs bstan srung / dbyug gu spun sogs nor lha bcas mdor na skyabs gnas rin po che thams cad kyis zhing gshegs dam pa de nyid dngos 'drar byin gyis brlabs nas bstan 'gro spyi dang bye brag bstan rgyas gling /

dpal zan yangs rdo rje gdan gyi chos srid legs tshogs thams cad nag phyogs bdud dbang du skad cig tsam yang mi 'gro bar sngon gyi mkhan slob chos gsum skyes chen dam pa rnams kyi thugs bskyed smon lam ji ltar mdzad pa bzhin 'grub ste mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa bstsal du gsol// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ sbus skyed rten gyi 'dod gsol/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
